message:
Add lua-openresty-yar0slav submission

OpenResty serves the Conduit API itself (Front: direct): one nginx worker per core; Postgres through pgmoon 1.18.0 with every statement prepared once per connection (generic plans, JIT off), buffered reads of replies and a semaphore-capped pool of 8 connections per worker; bcrypt via Ubuntu's libcrypt in an nginx thread pool; HS256 via OpenSSL's HMAC. install.sh survives the box's nginx holding port 80. Passes the conformance suite (197/197).

On a 4 vCPU / 8 GB droplet it holds 9,000 users for 5 minutes; the reference Go server fails at 7,000 on the same box. Full history is on branch lua-openresty-yar0slav.
